details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) A specific workflow or phase (for example review autofix, the orchestrator poller, clarify, plan, implement or validate). Name it in your answer. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Documentation only (README, docs/, agents.d fragments)
C) Tests or CI only (ci.yml, contract tests, run time)
D) Something else. Describe it in your answer.
Q2: What does "better" mean here?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure. Give a run link, issue or PR number, or the error text. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Make it faster or cheaper (fewer API calls, tokens or minutes)
C) Make it more reliable (fewer stalls, retries or human escalations)
D) Add a new feature or capability. Describe it.
Q3: How do we know the work is done?
Choices:
A) A concrete check you name, such as a failing test, a log line, or a metric threshold (RECOMMENDED)
B) A specific reproduction stops occurring (link it)
C) No measurable check; the change is complete when the described edit lands
